invocation.command:
cd /Users/davidbowman/projects/wg-basic
echo "=== does docs/development.md have a 'local netd' anchor? ==="
grep -n "^#\+ .*[Nn]etd\|^#\+ " docs/development.md
echo
echo "=== set_password_at / status_at definitions ==="
grep -rn "fn set_password_at\|fn status_at" src/management/*.rs
echo
echo "=== does state init happen implicitly? ==="
grep -rn "set_password_at\|StateStore::open\|initialize" src/management/credentials*.rs src/management/*.rs 2>/dev/null | head -20
